objective: Measure the paired-difference dispersion of E2-C4's three pre-registered contrasts on the five frozen units (8 fresh seeds each), plus the P4 policy level readings, so the confirmatory replicate count R can be derived from this experiment's own variance instead of inherited from E1-C4's 64.
role: This job tests no claim. It reads spread and per-unit levels only: it reports no contrast mean, direction, interval or p-value, so both P2/P3 estimands remain unread until the confirmatory run. Its P4 comparability readings gate the E2-C4 lock (a unit that misses the frozen band forces the affected contrast to be narrowed before submission, never re-banded), and its wealth_variance reference level supplies Var_ref for the frozen rule delta := 0.50 * Var_ref.

data_checksums.generated_inputs: the script re-verifies the frozen seed window against the seeds ledger and records every per-seed input digest in run_specs.json before execution

failure_policy: A failed module is an implementation problem, never a result: a P1 identity violation, a run that fails its own steady-window check, or a report that cannot be assembled stops the batch and must be fixed and re-run. A P4 comparability miss does not fail the pilot but gates the E2 lock: the affected contrast is narrowed and registered as inconclusive in advance, and no band, unit or delta may be adjusted from these readings.
